analysis_contract.AP_clock: midpoint of device-clock HAL read brackets; sensor update/cache age unknown
analysis_contract.AP_interpolation: linear boundaries within10s gap; trapezoidal mean; no extrapolation
analysis_contract.P95: nearest-rank service-window completed successes; show all-planned on-time counts and drain separately
analysis_contract.code_or_parameters_after_confirm_start: no reselection or coefficient changes; failures preserved; no repeated slots

control_costs.overlap_and_WAIT: actual device events; capacity/max2/order/timer/real release verified

analysis_contract.cost_interpretation: report every service harm first; restrict cost interpretation to equal complete work and service nonworsening; never claim verified energy saving
analysis_contract.denominator: all planned arrivals; retain failed/unstarted/pending requests
analysis_contract.model_forecast: explicit NOT_CREATED_NO_MODEL_ACCURACY_CLAIM; no fabricated initial latent state or unresolved energy scale
analysis_contract.primary_decision: descriptive and Pareto tradeoff only; do not adopt via reward or invented SLA/measurement tolerance
analysis_contract.prior_version_changes: only per-activity keep-screen-on; same models, inputs, queues, deadlines, warmups, coefficients; unresident declares2/runtime but resident0 means actual0; original contracts preserved
analysis_contract.quality: exact model/image/tensor binding and original decoded score0.001/box2px CPU reference; no broad-image or full-raw-tensor accuracy claim
analysis_contract.representative_selection: first registered complete common block for M128 BASE/PAIR_G; no KPI ranking
analysis_contract.uncertainty: each independent block paired difference; unadjusted two-sided95% Student-t; n<2 intervalnull; exploratory small n; no missing-data replacement

representative_rule: first registered block with both M128 BASE/PAIR_G; selected without performance ranking
